attr.title: Flight Sim
attr.desc: A first-person flight simulator with a full HUD, real terrain and airports, flight plans and ILS approaches. Fly aircraft from the Cessna 172 to the Boeing 747 on the JSBSim flight model.
attr.inst: Copy Flight Sim.sh and the flightsim folder to your ports folder. Build a data pack on a PC (see the project docs) and put it in flightsim/data. Exit with Select + Start.
